name: Steamed Water Chestnuts (Canned Slices, Simmered Tender)
whyItWorks: Peeled canned water chestnuts sliced and simmered in broth or soup. While crisp, their cellular structure retains water and softens with prolonged simmering; chew carefully.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Rinse canned slices thoroughly under running water. Simmer in soup broth or stir-fry sauce for 10 minutes to heat through and soften.
